_about: One entry per platform. Change a number or add your own platform here (copy an entry). 'verified' means the limit was read on the platform's own page on 'checked'; false means it came from other sites or from use, so look again before you rely on it.

threads.name: Threads
threads.tone: Short spoken lines. The first post is the hook and has the best image. One idea per post in the chain. A link, if any, goes in the last post.
threads.source: 500 characters: Meta Threads API docs (developers.facebook.com/docs/threads/posts). Images: the API allows 20 in a carousel; in the app 10 is the safe number, so 10 here.

naver.name: Naver blog
naver.tone: Long form. A clear title with the search words. Short paragraphs with a heading every few paragraphs, a picture between paragraphs. Tags at the end.
naver.source: No official page found for the tag or image limits (help.naver.com did not come up). 30 tags is what the editor is commonly reported to take. minChars is our own guide, not Naver's.

x.name: X
x.tone: Very short. Korean letters count 2 and every link counts 23 (weighted length), so a Korean post holds about 140 letters.
x.source: 280 weighted characters and the weights: X's open twitter-text v3 config. 4 images per post: X help center.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.tone: First person, plain, a little more work-like. The first two lines show before 'see more', so the point goes there.
linkedin.source: 3,000 characters and 20 photos: LinkedIn Help answer 100983 (linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/100983).

instagram.name: Instagram
instagram.tone: The pictures carry the post: slide 1 is the hook, the last slide says what to do. The caption is short; the first line shows in the feed.
instagram.source: 2,200 characters and 20 slides: widely reported, not read on an Instagram page. 5 hashtags: reported from Instagram's December 2025 change; some sites still say 30, so 5 is the safe number.

tistory.name: Tistory
tistory.tone: Like the Naver blog post, with headings people search for.
tistory.source: No official limits found. Our own guide numbers.

brunch.name: Brunch
brunch.tone: An essay. Fewer headings, longer thought, still your spoken voice.
brunch.source: No official limits found. Our own guide numbers.
